combat.offer: BUBBA: HOLD ON, DARLIN'. BEFORE YOU SWING AT ANYTINK, DO YOU WANT ME TA WALK YOU THROUGH DA BUTTONS?
normal: BUBBA: IN BATTLE, WE TAKE TURNS BY [SPEED | speed], FASTEST FIRST. PICK A COMMAND AN' PRESS [CONTINUE]!
BUBBA: [ATTACK | Attack] STRIKES DA BAD 'UN WIT YA EQUIPPED [WEAPON | weapon]. YOU CAN ALWAYS USE DIS!
BUBBA: [SKILLS | Skills] IZ YA SPECIAL ATTACKS AN' SPELLS. USING DEM COSTS [MP] OR [AP]!
BUBBA: [DEFENSE | Defense] PROTECTS YOU AN' CUTS INCOMIN' [DAMAGE | damage] FOR DA ROUND!
BUBBA: [RELOAD | Reload] APPEARS WHEN HOLDIN' A GUN. IT REFILLS YA [AMMO | ammo] AN' GUARDS YOU!
BUBBA: [SWITCH | Switch] LETS YOU FOLD YA [VECTOR GUN | vector gun] INTO ITS OTHER FORM, COSTIN' [NO TURN | no turn]!
BUBBA: [BACKPACK | Backpack] LETS YOU USE [ITEMS | items] YOU CARRY, LIKE MEDICINE OR FOOD!
BUBBA: [ACTIONS | Actions] HAB EXTRA MOVES LIKE [AIM | Aim] AT BODY PARTS, [THROW | Throw], AN' [WRESTLE | Wrestle]!
BUBBA: [TALK | Talk] TRIES WORDS FIRST. SOME BAD 'UNS CAN BE TALKED DOWN WITOUT VIOLENCE!
BUBBA: [RUN | Run] GETS DA WHOLE PARTY OUT OF DANGER. IT ALWAYS WORKS WHEN YOU NEED TA [ESCAPE | escape]!
map: BUBBA: DIS FIGHT HAPPENS RIGHT ON DA MAP. WE TAKE TURNS IN ORDER OF [SPEED | speed]!
BUBBA: [MOVE | Move] LETS YOU WALK ACROSS TILES BEFORE ACTIN'. HOW FAR YOU GO DEPENDS ON YA [DEX]!
BUBBA: [ATTACK | Attack] HAB A TILE [RANGE | range]. MAKE SURE YOU IZ CLOSE ENOUGH TA REACH DA TARGET!
BUBBA: [SKILLS | Skills] IZ SPECIAL MOVES AN' SPELLS POINTED AT A SPECIFIC TILE!
BUBBA: [BACKPACK | Backpack] LETS YOU USE [ITEMS | items] FROM YA LOOT SACK RIGHT WHERE YOU STAND!
BUBBA: [ACTIONS | Actions] HAB TACTICAL MOVES LIKE [AIM | Aim], [THROW | Throw], AN' [WRESTLE | Wrestle]!
BUBBA: MOVE DA [CURSOR | cursor] TA CHOOSE YA TARGET TILE AN' PRESS [CONTINUE]!
BUBBA: [RUN | Run] LEADS DA WHOLE PARTY AWAY TA [ESCAPE | escape] DA BATTLE!
combat.rearm: BUBBA: NO PROBLEM DARLIN', ME IZ NO MAGIC EXPERT BUT ME CAN RETEACH YOU HOW TA SHOOT YA GUN! YOU NEED TA FIGURE OUT DA REST YOURSELF

BUBBA, YOU OAF. YOU WAZ SUPPOSED TA SEE DIS WIT ME!
ME STILL SET OUT TWO CUPS IN DA MORNIN'. OLD HABITS!
EVERY ROAD WE PLANNED TOGETHER, ME IZ WALKIN' ALONE NOW!
HE WOULD HAB LAUGHED AT ME FOR CRYIN'. SO ME WILL NO. NO HERE!
